result: Schedule-Free SGD drops the learning-rate schedule and the stopping time: take SGD steps on z, report the running average x, and evaluate gradients at y = (1 − β)z + βx. It is optimal for convex Lipschitz problems for any β (DG/√T) and matches or beats schedules tuned for a known horizon in practice.
result_plain: SGD on z, average x, gradients at y = (1 − β)z + βx: no schedule, no horizon, optimal convex rate.
